newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 6.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 6.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Tuesday:
* On the Wall Street, the Dow Jones industrial average rises to a record 7,215, up 144 points
* Some overseas funds expected to return to buying
* On Monday, the blue-chip Composite Index ended 2.99 points lower at 1,094.57.

* Focus to continue on MBf Capital and Suria Capital, which have been active on rumours of merger between the two. MBf Capital told the stock exchange on Monday it was not aware of any reasons for the unusual activity.
* Market expected to look at construction companies related to Malaysia's new federal capital, Putra Jaya, according to Phua Lee Kerk, head of research at Jupiter Securities.

* "After Hong Leong (Properties') deal with Putrajaya Holdings yesterday, the market should be looking at other possible gainers from Putra Jaya," he said, adding that MRCB and Bandaraya Development would be in focus.
* Hong Leong said it would develop a residential and commercial property project jointly with Putra Jaya Holdings in the new federal capital being built just outside Kuala Lumpur.
* Market fishing for leads in the absence of major corporate direction setters, brokers say.
